name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Either Crane goes with Poison or Bathing goes with Blackwood.
Ravenscroft, Dagger, and Poison go with Bathing, Sleeping, and Writing, in some order.
Crane, Bathing, and Sleeping go with Dagger, Poison, and Rope, in some order.
If Blackwood goes with Bathing, then either Blackwood does not go with Dagger or Rope goes with Crane (but not both).
Either Ravenscroft goes with Pistol or Writing goes with Rope.

hints.text: Suppose Ravenscroft went with Reading — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Ravenscroft goes with Reading.
Ravenscroft goes with Reading, so it can't also go with Bathing.
Ravenscroft goes with Reading, so it can't also go with Sleeping.
Ravenscroft goes with Reading, so it can't also go with Writing.
…but now the clue “Ravenscroft, Dagger, and Poison go with Bathing, Sleeping, and Writing, in some order” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Ravenscroft does not go with Reading.
